H1.basis: PG-R4 (first use after the boundary is not prior history; overlap requires in-scope use); PG-R7 (resume needs an independently verified disposition and a fresh lead release bound to the hold, PG-R8 only when new history is involved); contract section 6 (verified disproval plus fresh lead release lets the original binding continue); plan W6 (proven disproval, post-boundary use); schema LeadContinuation disposition 'CONTINUE or RELEASE'
H1.disposition: FIX REQUIRED (research-lead ruling 2026-10-05: a hold is provisional; forced cancellation/NOT EVALUABLE after disproval or post-boundary-only first use is materially wrong)
required_change: verify_history classifies each proof as prior use, post-boundary use, conclusive disproval or uncertain. Conclusive disproval needs an explicit 'disproval' statement corroborated by the read-back authoritative execution receipt: NOT_EXECUTED (proof actual_execution false and receipt started false) or OUT_OF_SCOPE (proof scope_verified true and receipt scope OUT_OF_SCOPE). A false or unverified field without that statement stays SUSPICION (missing evidence never exonerates)

Batch order: proven overlap -> OVERLAP (M1); any uncertain proof -> SUSPICION; pre-boundary history -> NEW_HISTORY; post-boundary use only -> POST_BOUNDARY; otherwise DISPROVED. Post-boundary and disproved values are recorded separately in the receipt and never extend pre-boundary history
An independent-verifier step under the exact active hold produces the receipt and retains its raw proofs and execution receipts

A lead RELEASE (LeadContinuation disposition RELEASE, AuthorityEvent RELEASE) for DISPROVED or POST_BOUNDARY at PARTIAL_GENERATION through FINAL_PUBLIC binds the hold tip, the independent receipt and its raw inputs; during partial generation it also binds the producer's sealed PrefixSnapshot. No supplement is required because no new pre-boundary history exists. The authority accepts it only for a registered independent verifier's DISPROVED/POST_BOUNDARY receipt with empty pre-boundary history
W (verify_complete_private) accepts a disproval-release chain segment and independently reproduces its receipt from the retained raw inputs against the complete list
BEFORE_GENERATION is unchanged: a hold there is not terminal and resolves through the existing inventory-gate renewal route
required_tests: per-proof classification, including that missing evidence stays SUSPICION and that an unsupported disproval statement fails closed
release after disproval and after post-boundary-only use at completed stages and at FINAL_PUBLIC; consumers resume and the original records stay immutable
release during partial generation in the real injected producer run: draws resume under the RELEASE tip and W passes on the completed payload with the disproval segment in its chain

authority rejection of a disproval release with SUSPICION/NEW_HISTORY/OVERLAP receipts, non-empty pre-boundary history, a non-independent verifier, a missing PrefixSnapshot during partial generation, or a CONTINUE kind; BEFORE_GENERATION disproval release rejected
H1.summary: No release path after conclusive disproval or post-boundary-only first use; a hold can only end in CANCELLED_PRECOLLECTION_UNRESOLVED_INTEGRITY or NOT EVALUABLE

M3.basis: schema C acceptance predicates (no seeds, salt, private paths or raw diagnostics); schema U acceptance predicates (verifier checks sanitized content before publication)
M3.disposition: ACCEPTED FOR CORRECTION (promoted on the research lead's stated inclination 2026-10-05: comparing against actual private values is a much stronger invariant)
required_change: publication compares the canonical C text against the actual private values read back under authority: every accepted position and raw audit candidate (16-hex in either case, and decimal tokens), every K member, the 32-byte salt (hex in either case, standard and URL-safe base64) and the private authority/producer roots in both separator forms

M4.basis: R11 (W: independent verifier; acceptance predicate 'Recompute all private bytes and c'); contract 'W verifies c without binding U or C'; R12/R13 bind c by equality to W; DS-W7-01 is implemented by verify_W_bytes and the recomputation in verify_complete_private, both qualified
M4.disposition: RULED, NO CHANGE. The authority for c: the producer's completion path computes c over the exact payload and salt (c is not a field of S); W, the independent private verifier, is the sole authoritative recomputation of c; U, C and D consume c by exact equality with W, which is enforced. Consumer-side recomputation is not a protocol requirement and is not added (the consumer half of the finding is nullified). A dedicated W-record producer stays with gate 8, as recorded for review-02 M-3, and is a declared limitation of the qualification boundary
M4.summary: No code path produces W under private_verification, and consumers never recompute c

M5.disposition: FIX REQUIRED (research-lead ruling 2026-10-05: record whether entropy is real or injected/synthetic)
required_change: Generator mode is an explicit required argument with no default

the producer binds a private entropy-source declaration (mode, draw and salt sources, study, G, operation) in GenerationBoundary.evidence, and every boundary read requires it to match the producer's mode, so a resumed producer cannot switch sources
verify_complete_private requires exactly one declaration, requires the verifier to state the expected source explicitly, and reports entropy_source in its PASS result
required_tests: constructor without mode rejected; declaration bound in a real boundary; resumed producer with the other mode rejected before any draw; W rejects missing, duplicate or mismatched declarations and reports SYNTHETIC for synthetic payloads
M5.summary: The entropy source (REAL vs SYNTHETIC) is bound in no record and SYNTHETIC is the constructor default
